name: Hollow hold
summary: On your back, press the lower back down and lift the legs and shoulders so the body is a shallow banana.
setup: Lie on your back, side-on to the phone at floor level. Press the lower back into the floor, lift the straight legs and the shoulders a little, arms by the sides or overhead. Hold.
brief: Lie on your back. Press the lower back into the floor, lift the straight legs and the shoulders a little, arms by the sides or overhead.
why: From the side the legs are held above the floor, so the timer runs while they stay up. The back arching is hidden.
regression: Knees bent, or one leg at a time.
contraindications: Lower back pain in the hold.

faults.label: Lower back arching
faults.tip: Raise the legs higher until the back can stay flat; lower them over weeks.

faults.label: Neck straining
faults.tip: Look at the knees, not the ceiling.

guide.cannotSee: The lower back leaving the floor.

points.t: Flat on the floor; shoulders slightly lifted.
